_comment: Honors and fellowships shown on awards.html and in the CV. Text uses **bold** and [link text](url). After editing run: python scripts/build.py and python scripts/build_cv.py Optional "note" fields are private and never shown.

items.text: **3rd place** in the **Simulation Challenge** at the [IEEE Winter Simulation Conference 2025](https://meetings.informs.org/wordpress/wsc2025/) ($1,000).
**1st place** in the **[Brazilian Ministry of Defense Doctoral Award](https://www.gov.br/defesa/pt-br)** 2025 for the best Ph.D. thesis in defense science and technology (R$4,000).
**WSC Diversity Award** at the [IEEE Winter Simulation Conference 2024](https://meetings.informs.org/wordpress/wsc2024/) in Orlando, USA.
**Runner-up Best Poster Award** at the [LACORO Summer School on Robotics 2024](https://www.lacoro.org/2024/) in Chile.

**2nd place** in the **[Performance Review Commission (PRC) Data Challenge 2024](https://prc-data-challenge.netlify.app/)** with an open [Machine Learning model to infer flight Actual TakeOff Weight (ATOW)](https://github.com/PRC-Data-Challenge-2024/team_tiny_rainbow).
**ML and Systems Rising Star 2024**, awarded by [MLCommons](https://mlcommons.org/2024/06/2024-mlc-rising-stars/).
**3rd place** in the **[Data Science Challenge 2023](https://comp.ita.br/dsc/edicoes/2023/)** for predicting the Estimated Landing Time (ELDT) of flights.
**Best PhD Colloquium Award** at the [Conference on Principles of Advanced Discrete Simulation (PADS) 2023](https://sigsim.acm.org/conf/pads/2023/).

**3rd place** in the **[5th Brazilian Competition on Knowledge Discovery in Databases (KDD-BR)](https://www.kaggle.com/c/kddbr-2021)**, predicting solutions of the Travelling Salesman Problem (R$200).
**Military Bronze Medal**, awarded by the [Brazilian Air Force](https://www.fab.mil.br/index.php).
**Ambassador Award of Excellence** 2019, [International Youth Math Challenge (IYMC)](https://iymc.info/en/jodantas).

**6th place** (39 competitors) in the **[3rd Brazilian Competition on Knowledge Discovery in Databases (KDD-BR)](https://www.kaggle.com/c/kddbr-2019)**, predicting flight delays for a Brazilian airline.

**4th place** in the **[Data Science Challenge at Engineering Education for the Future (EEF) 2019](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/data-science-challenge-at-eef-2019/)**, predicting real estate prices.
**Honorable Mention** in the Department of Humanities, [Aeronautics Institute of Technology](https://www.ita.br/).
**Military Merit Award**, [Brazilian Air Force](https://www.fab.mil.br/index.php) (top 25% behavioral grades).
**1st place overall** in the [Brazilian Air Force Reserve Officer Training Corps (CPORAER-SJ)](https://cporaersj.dcta.mil.br/) (120 candidates).
**ITA Entrance Exam Approval** at the [Aeronautics Institute of Technology](https://www.ita.br/) (120 admitted out of 7,627 applicants), one of Brazil's most competitive entrance exams.
**Academic Merit Award**, [Brazilian Air Force](https://www.fab.mil.br/index.php) (top 25% military grades).
**Bronze Medal** in the **[10th Brazilian Olympiad of Astronomy and Astronautics (OBA)](https://www.oba.org.br/)** (187,726 competitors).
**Honorable Mention** in the **XIV Ceara Science Olympiad — Biology (OCC)**, [Federal University of Ceara (UFC)](https://www.ufc.br/pt).
**Gold Medal in the Internal Science Olympiads 2006** (Math, Physics, Biology), [Farias Brito High School](https://www.fariasbrito.com.br/).
**Honor to Merit** (three 2nd places, one 5th place) in the **Internal Mathematics Olympiad**, [Christus Middle School](https://www.christus.com.br/).
**2nd place in the 3rd Christus Exhibition of Science and Technology (EXCETEC)**, category "Exact, Social and Commercial Sciences".

**DAAD AInet Fellow** (AI in Neuroscience), [German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD)](https://www.daad.de/en/the-daad/postdocnet/), Postdoctoral Networking Tour in Artificial Intelligence (Postdoc-NeT-AI).
**Travel Grant** ($1,000) to attend the [IEEE Winter Simulation Conference 2025](https://meetings.informs.org/wordpress/wsc2025/) in Seattle, USA.

**Travel Grant** ($1,500), [LatinX in AI Coalition](https://www.latinxinai.org/), for the [LatinX in AI Research Workshop](https://www.latinxinai.org/neurips-2025) at [NeurIPS 2025](https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2025), San Diego, USA.
**DAC Young Fellow** for the [Design Automation Conference (DAC) 2025](https://dac.com/).
**Travel Grant** (€2,900), [CISB](https://cisb.org.br/) Call 15/2025, for the [2025 Swedish Aerospace Congress](https://ft2025.se/).
**Travel Grant** ($1,000) to attend the [IEEE Winter Simulation Conference 2024](https://meetings.informs.org/wordpress/wsc2024/) in Orlando, USA.
**Travel Grant** ($500) to attend the [LACORO Summer School on Robotics 2024](https://www.lacoro.org/2024/) in Chile.
**Travel Grant** ($1,000) to attend the [2024 Conference on Principles of Advanced Discrete Simulation (PADS)](https://sigsim.acm.org/conf/pads/2024/).
**Travel Grant** ($3,000) to attend the [UNODA-SIPRI Workshop on Responsible AI for Peace and Security](https://disarmament.unoda.org/en) in Brussels.

**Travel Grant** (€3,150), [CISB](https://cisb.org.br/) Call 13/2024, for the [WARA‑PS Demonstration Week 2024](https://web.archive.org/web/20240419125501/https://portal.waraps.org/page/wara-ps-demonstration-week).
**Travel Grant** (€3,200), [CISB](https://cisb.org.br/) Call 10/2022, for an AI researchers delegation in Sweden.
**Travel Grant** ($1,000) to attend the [Conference on Principles of Advanced Discrete Simulation (PADS) 2023](https://sigsim.acm.org/conf/pads/2023/) in Orlando, USA.
**Travel Grant** ($2,500) to attend [Brazil at Silicon Valley 2023](https://brazilatsiliconvalley.com/) in Santa Clara, USA.
**Merit Scholarship**, [Fundação Estudar](https://www.estudar.org.br/comunidade-de-lideres/), awarded for outstanding trajectory and academic potential (30 of 33,876 applicants).
**[Prolider](https://www.programaprolider.com.br/) Program Fellow** 2016, selected by [Instituto Four](https://www.institutofour.org/) (29 of 2,013 applicants).
**Full Scholarship** (≈$75,000) from Brazil's Ministry of Education for a one-year study program at Stony Brook University, College of Engineering.

**Undergraduate Research Fellowship** ([PIBIC](http://memoria.cnpq.br/pibic)), [CNPq](https://www.gov.br/cnpq/pt-br), at the Aeronautics Institute of Technology, for the project "Automatic Data Acquisition in Plasma Tunnel Tests".

**Undergraduate Research Fellowship** ([PIBIC](http://memoria.cnpq.br/pibic)), [CNPq](https://www.gov.br/cnpq/pt-br), at the Aeronautics Institute of Technology, for the project "Thermionic Cathode Discharge in Low Pressure".
**Full Scholarship** (≈$30,000) for three years at **[Farias Brito High School](https://www.fariasbrito.com.br/)**.
